name: SupermarQ
description: SupermarQ is an application-oriented quantum benchmark suite developed by the SuperTech group. It focuses on practical quantum algorithms including QAOA, VQE, and Hamiltonian simulation with scalable problem sizes. SupermarQ provides both algorithm implementations and standardized metrics for evaluating quantum hardware performance on real-world applications.
significance: Application-oriented benchmark suite bridging the gap between abstract hardware metrics and real algorithm performance evaluation.

news.title: Quantum WalkScore: New Application-Oriented Benchmark Tests Quantum Walk and Amplitude Amplification on IBM Hardware
news.excerpt: Researchers Noé Olivier and Michel Nowak introduced Quantum WalkScore (QWS), a scalable application-oriented benchmark assessing NISQ and fault-tolerant quantum processors on discrete-time quantum walks and quantum amplitude amplification for graph nodefinding. QWS scores the largest problem size at which a target node is found with success probability above a threshold, validated experimentally across multiple generations of IBM quantum processors.
